title: Juice N Power Strawberry Lemonade Berries Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: This would be a delicious lemonade eliquid all by itself, but the addition of sweet, ripe strawberries and other red berries, takes it to another level entirely. Fresh, tangy and sweet, Strawberry Lemonade Berries Salt by Juice N Power is an irresistible all-day vape. This premium e-liquid’s 50VG/50PG blend offers the perfect balance between flavour and cloud production and the nicotine salt solution makes it ideal for use in classic e-cigarette starter vape kits and pod vape devices. Perfect for recent ex-smokers or vapers seeking the immediate, satisfying nicotine relief provided by nic salts with a super-smooth throat hit.
